claim.claim-text: 2. The system of claim 1, wherein the relevant information is used along with network information to identify physical layer resources required for a customer application.
3. The system of claim 1, wherein the edge computing layer generates at least one radio access network (RAN) command to change at least one RAN parameter.

4. The system of claim 1, wherein the network resources are optimized by reconfiguring at least one parameter of a core network and/or the edge computing layer associated with the network slice or the subnetwork.
5. The system of claim 1, wherein the edge computing layer analyzes detected signal information from the analyzed data or the measured data.
6. The system of claim 5, wherein the detected signal information includes a center frequency and bandwidth of at least one signal.

7. The system of claim 6, wherein the edge computing layer is operable to obtain statistical information and analyze possible interactions based on the center frequency and the bandwidth of each of the at least one signal to create the analyzed data.
9. The method of claim 8, further comprising determining channel availability in the electromagnetic environment.

10. The method of claim 8, further comprising providing a quality of a channel to a network operator and receiving a request for use of the channel from the network operator based on the quality of the channel.
11. The method of claim 8, further comprising the edge computing layer determining a location of at least one user equipment (UE) device.
12. The method of claim 8, further comprising providing optimization of service to at least one user equipment (UE) device based on a predicted future location of at least one UE device.
13. The method of claim 8, further comprising identifying physical layer resources required for a customer application using the relevant information and network information.
15. The method of claim 14, further comprising determining channel availability in the electromagnetic environment.

16. The method of claim 14, further comprising providing a quality of a channel to a network operator and receiving a request for use of the channel from the network operator based on the quality of the channel.

17. The method of claim 14, further comprising the edge computing layer providing procedures for migration and/or service continuity based on a predicted future location of at least one user equipment (UE) device.
18. The method of claim 14, further comprising creating a relocation group including at least one edge computing host pre-configured to run the customer application.
